metadata.description: Transgenia's Odoo tooling for Claude: a unified MCP server and CLI for Community, Enterprise and online instances across Odoo 10-19. Built by Transgenia, a Registered partner of Anthropic.

plugins.name: odoo-tools
plugins.description: Connect Claude to Odoo Community, Enterprise and Online (versions 10-19) through an MCP server with a permission policy and a cross-version compatibility layer, plus a CLI fallback. The Odoo tools run in Claude Code, including the Code tab of Claude Desktop; in Cowork and Claude chat the skills and commands load without the tools. Assisted setup by Transgenia: dev@transgenia.org.
